remarks: Beautiful, Spacious and Bright! 2 Bedroom, 1.5 Bath ranch unit located on 2nd floor of desirable Heywood Heights Complex!! High quality hardwood floors throughout. Updated kitchen with granite counters, newer stainless-steel appliances, sink & microwave. Both bedrooms are generously sized with large closets. Plenty of storage space in the unit and a separate private storage room in the basement. Stackable washer and dryer inside the unit. Large living room with a wet bar and oversized sliders which open up to the private balcony with views of the pool. Many walking paths to enjoy throughout the professionally landscaped complex. Well maintained in-ground pool for you and your guests and clubhouse for private parties. Close to I-95, Metro North, Shopping, Restaurants & Downtown Stamford. Very convenient to midtown Manhattan.
